rows.text: Shoes on shelf, bags on hooks

laundryNote: LAUNDRY — one load a day, start to finish: Nick starts it · Trish moves it and folds · a missed load goes first tomorrow

lines: 1 · Wipe down the fridge, microwave, dishwasher, and oven
2 · Load or unload the dishwasher — and take the kitchen trash out if it is full
1 · Tidy: blankets folded, coffee table clear
1 · Chairs in + placemats straight — or wipe the table when there are none
2 · Clear the table bare except the flowers

chart.subtitle: Zones rotate every Monday. Three jobs each. Missed chores roll to the next reset, never a punishment cleanup.
chart.everyDay: Clear your plate · shoes on the shelf · laundry in the hamper · 5-minute tidy before bed
chart.weekend: Saturday morning is Deep Clean: the twelve zones, one at a time, 20 minutes each, on the Reset page. Sunday is rest, plus ten minutes to empty the family inbox basket by the front door.
chart.note: Everything with no home lands in the family inbox basket by the front door. If you do not know where something goes, it goes in the basket, not on a counter.

crewJobs.title: PUT AWAY FOOD
crewJobs.desc: Leftovers into containers, containers into the fridge. Nothing lives on the counter overnight.

crewJobs.title: WIPE IT DOWN
crewJobs.desc: Table, stove, and countertops wiped. The kitchen you leave is the kitchen you get tomorrow.

crewJobs.title: SWEEP / SWIFFER
crewJobs.desc: Dining room and kitchen floors, swept or Swiffered. Chairs back where they belong.

rhythm.job: Sweep the entryway and the laundry hallway
Fridge and pantry check: toss expired, do one shelf
20-minute family reset, a little deeper (Deep Clean)
Rest. Empty the family inbox basket (10 minutes)

resetZones.name: 1 · Dining table
resetZones.done: Bare wood except the flowers. Everything else has a home or goes in the family inbox basket.

resetZones.name: 2 · Dining Room Organize
resetZones.done: Sideboard and shelves straight. Chairs in place. Nothing stored on the table or under it.

resetZones.name: 3 · Kitchen bar counter
resetZones.done: Clear except the coffee maker. Cups back in the cabinet, keep 6 out.

resetZones.name: 4 · Sink + dishwasher
resetZones.done: Sink empty. Dishwasher loaded and running. Drying rack clear.

resetZones.name: 5 · Entryway
resetZones.done: Boxes broken down and out. One pair of shoes per person. Backpacks on hooks. Floor clear.

resetZones.name: 6 · Living room
resetZones.done: Coffee table: remotes and one book only. Blankets folded on the couch. Piano top clear.

resetZones.name: 7 · Laundry zone
resetZones.done: One load in the machine. Sorter bags not overflowing. No laundry on the floor.

resetZones.name: 8 · Utility Room
resetZones.done: Machine tops clear. Supplies in the cabinet, doors shut. Brooms and dustpan in their corner. Floor swept, walkway clear.

resetZones.name: 9 · Bedroom
resetZones.done: Bed made. Floor clear. Dresser top clear except the lamp. Shoes put away.

resetZones.name: 10 · Linen closet
resetZones.done: Linens only, folded. One shelf per kind: towels, sheets, blankets. Clothes out.

resetZones.name: 11 · Closet floor
resetZones.done: You can see the floor. Clothes hanging or in drawers. One donate bag lives here.

resetZones.name: 12 · Bathroom
resetZones.done: Sink and counter wiped, mirror spotless, trash out. Towels hanging straight, floor clear, spare roll in sight.
